jobs.description:
Reports to: Director

Role and Responsibilities
The Business Manager is responsible for the effective management, operation, development and administration of the school's Finance, HR, Payroll and Reception functions, ensuring efficient processes, sound financial management and compliance with applicable legislation, regulations and internal policies.
Finance and Financial Management
Overall responsibility for the school's financial management, including accounting, financial reporting, budgeting and financial projections.
Lead long-term financial and cash flow planning, and provide financial analysis and decision-making support to the Director, Senior Leadership Team  and the Board of Trustees.
Lead and coordinate the annual budget process and ongoing budget follow-up.
Ensure monthly reconciliations, financial monitoring and reporting.
Oversee year-end reconciliations, accruals, financial statements, closing procedures and external audits.
Establish, maintain and monitor effective internal controls and financial procedures.
Oversee procurement, purchasing, contract management and related administrative processes.

HR, Payroll and Personnel Administration
Oversee the school's HR, payroll and personnel administration functions, ensuring effective processes and compliance with applicable employment legislation, collective agreements and internal policies.
Ensure appropriate coordination of recruitment, employment matters, payroll administration and related personnel processes.

Reception and Administrative Services
Oversee the operation and development of Reception, ensuring effective day-to-day service and appropriate administrative support to the school community.

Policies, Governance and Compliance
Develop, implement and maintain policies, guidelines and procedures within the department's areas of responsibility.
Manage relevant cases, investigations and consultation processes relating to Finance, HR, Payroll and Reception.
Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, regulatory requirements and internal governance frameworks.

Leadership and Management
Lead and manage the Finance, Payroll, HR and Reception teams.
Lead the department, including planning, organising, prioritising and allocating work, setting objectives and following up on performance and results.
Manage, support and develop departmental staff, promoting collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.
Drive the development and improvement of departmental processes, systems and ways of working.
Exercise leadership in accordance with Swedish employment legislation, workplace practices and expectations of managers, recognising that collaboration, open dialogue and employee participation are integral to how leadership is expected to be practised. Foster an inclusive and respectful working environment where employees are encouraged to contribute, share perspectives and take an active part in matters affecting their work.

External Relations and Organisational Responsibilities
Represent the school in external meetings, professional forums and networks within the areas of responsibility.
Contribute as a member of the School´s Senior Leadership Team, supporting strategic planning, decision-making and the overall development of the school.
Report to the School Director.

To succeed in this role, we believe you have
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Business Administration or a related field.
Extensive knowledge of accounting, financial closing processes and financial reporting.
Strong analytical skills and experience in business and operational performance management.
The ability to translate financial information into actionable recommendations and well-founded decision-making support.
A solid understanding of profitability analysis, and cash flow
A good understanding of HR and Payroll processes.
Good verbal and written communication in English and Swedish. 

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check for the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

What we offer
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of: a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our locations in central Stockholm are easily accessible by public transportation.
Contract
Employment Type: Permanent Administrative Position (with a six-month probationary period)
Employment Rate: 100%
Start Date: February 2027, or on another date as mutually agreed

Salary
Individually negotiated

Application
Last day for applications: November 30, 2026 (the interview process can start earlier).
We only accept applications in English and from qualified candidates.
Please send a letter of interest and your CV to application@intsch.se. Mark the email with “Business Manager”.
Please note that, in order to work at SIS, you must hold a valid work permit or be an EU citizen.
SIS reserves the right to close the application process at any time once a suitable candidate is found and accepts the position.

We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started. 
At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future — and we want you to be part of it. 
At Husqvarna Group, within Global Aftermarket Operations P&A, our Supply & Inventory Planning team ensures that products flow efficiently from our factories and external suppliers to our sales companies and distributors. Our mission is to provide customers with the right products, at the right time, while maintaining capital efficiency and operational excellence. 
We are now looking for a Supply & Inventory Planner to join our team in Huskvarna. In this role, you will act as a key interface between our product categories, factories, suppliers, and sales companies. You will collaborate closely with experienced team members in a dynamic, supportive, and results-driven environment, where teamwork and proactive problem-solving are essential for success. 
We are expanding our team and have both permanent and fixed-term opportunities available - making this a great time to join us. 
Key responsibilities 
Own your assortments delivery performance from our state-of-the-art distribution center in Stigamo, as well as our Regional Distribution Centers, meeting targets to exceed customer expectations. 
Be the link between product categories, sales companies, factories, and suppliers, using forecasts from our demand team to secure availability and efficient supply chain operations. 
Place orders and proactively monitor deliveries to ensure timely fulfillment. 
Pro-actively monitor supply risks, mitigate and escalate internally & externally. 
Balance availability and capital efficiency by managing inventory and driving the elimination of slow-moving articles within your assortment 
Maintain and continuously improve planning parameters and master data, including article setup and registration, to ensure accurate planning and execution. 
Be an active  part in product launches and phase-outs and support resolving quality issues. 
Drive improvements and play an active role in organizational change initiatives. 

Who we are looking for 
You are a structured, analytical, and driven problem solver who thrives in a collaborative environment. You demonstrate strong personal leadership traits, such as initiative, accountability, and adaptability, and you value the potential for continuous improvement and positive change. You are service-minded, flexible, and able to manage multiple stakeholders while balancing competing priorities. 
Your skills and background 
Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken. 
University degree in logistics, economics, or equivalent professional experience. 

You will be welcomed into a company and a culture that values collaboration, personal leadership, and continuous improvement. Whether you have recently graduated or already gained some relevant experience, we offer an opportunity to build your skills and grow within our organisation. You do not need to have all the answers from day one; what matters is your curiosity, willingness to learn, and motivation to contribute. 
Location: 
This position will be placed in Huskvarna, Sweden. We believe in a dynamic, energized workplace and day-to-day collaboration, and we meet in the office at least 4 days a week (80%). 
Your application 
Please submit your application in English as soon as possible as we review applications on an ongoing basis. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR regulations. 
For questions about the role, reach out to hiring manager Samuel Spjuth, at samuel.spjuth@husqvarnagroup.com.  
For questions about the recruitment process, reach out to Talent Acquisition Partner Nina Hallin at nina.hallin@husqvarnagroup.com.  
We look forward to hearing from you!  
Processing of personal data 
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. 
For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice. 
Winning Through Culture 
We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.     
Our culture is built on three core themes:   
Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities. 
Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.   
Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.   

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

jobs.occupation: Test Fleet Engineer  Expert | Vehicle Fleet Management - Automotive
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Test Fleet Engineer – Expert | Vehicle Fleet Management & Test Operations
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Test Engineer – Expert (Test Fleet Engineer)
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience
Language: English
Engagement: IT Consulting Assignment
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Test Fleet Engineer at Expert level to support advanced vehicle testing and engineering operations.
In this role, you will take responsibility for ensuring maximum availability and utilization of test vehicles throughout their lifecycle. You will work closely with project management, engineering teams, testing departments, workshops and external suppliers to ensure that vehicles are maintained, prepared and available for their planned test activities.
The position combines vehicle fleet management, technical coordination, project planning, logistics, problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
1. Test Fleet Management & Vehicle Uptime
Ensure maximum uptime and availability of the complete test vehicle fleet.
Act as the first point of support for vehicle uptime and coordinate support for field-test vehicles.
Proactively identify and resolve issues affecting vehicle availability.
Coordinate activities during unplanned vehicle stops, including workshop resources and necessary repairs.
Monitor vehicle utilization and identify opportunities to improve fleet efficiency.
Plan and coordinate vehicle maintenance between testing and loan periods.

2. Workshop & Technical Coordination
Coordinate internal and external workshop resources to ensure timely vehicle repairs and maintenance.
Identify, order and manage spare parts, materials and required services.
Arrange towing and special transportation between different testing locations.
Coordinate vehicle readiness and ensure appropriate documentation before transportation.
Manage external supplier activities and follow up on related invoices.
Ensure that vehicle modifications, updates and damages are properly documented.

3. Fleet Optimization & Project Coordination
Analyse individual vehicle and overall fleet utilization.
Optimize the number of vehicles required to support ongoing testing activities.
Coordinate timely divestment of vehicles to optimize fleet size and reduce unnecessary capital tied up in vehicles.
Participate in project meetings and lead actions related to vehicle uptime and fleet optimization.
Communicate requirements, provide recommendations and share knowledge with relevant stakeholders.
Ensure that project activities meet established test fleet requirements.

4. Logistics & International Transportation
Plan and coordinate vehicle transportation between testing facilities.
Organize special transport and towing requirements.
Coordinate resources and transportation documentation for vehicle export and import outside the EU.
Ensure vehicles are properly prepared and documented before transportation.

5. Continuous Improvement
Identify and implement improvements to fleet management processes and operating procedures.
Develop efficient methods to improve vehicle availability and utilization.
Document processes, share knowledge and contribute to long-term operational improvements.
Support engineering teams in achieving testing objectives through effective fleet planning and coordination.

Required Skills & Experience
Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in test engineering, vehicle operations, fleet management or related automotive engineering activities.
Strong understanding of vehicle systems and automotive product development.
Experience in vehicle fleet coordination, testing operations or technical project management.
Proven ability to manage multiple activities and coordinate different stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Experience coordinating workshops, repairs, maintenance and external suppliers.
Ability to analyse vehicle utilization and identify opportunities for operational optimization.
Good understanding of vehicle transportation and logistics processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience
Experience with the following systems and tools will be an advantage:
PROTOM
KOLA
GLORIA
IMPACT
BOSS

Additional experience in international vehicle transportation, customs-related documentation, test fleet lifecycle management and automotive project coordination is highly beneficial.
What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a senior engineering professional who can take ownership of vehicle fleet operations and proactively ensure that test vehicles are available, maintained and ready for planned testing activities.
The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, coordination and problem-solving capabilities, together with the ability to influence stakeholders, manage complex operational challenges and drive continuous improvements.
At expert level, you should also be comfortable mentoring colleagues, sharing technical knowledge and acting as a trusted point of contact for complex operational and technical matters.
Interested in This Opportunity?
Are you an experienced automotive professional with a background in test fleet management, vehicle operations or engineering coordination?
We would be happy to hear from you!
Apply directly through our careers page:
🌐 https://www.hykmann.com/careers
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB

Looking for a flexible part-time job alongside your studies or other commitments? Join Assessio's Global Support team and gain valuable experience in customer support, HR technology, and digital assessment solutions.
At Assessio, we believe in ZERO TALENT WASTE – helping organizations identify, develop, and make the most of people's potential.
We're looking for a proactive, service-minded, and Dutch-speaking Customer Support Agent to join our Global Support team on a part-time basis.
Whether you're a university student looking to gain professional experience or someone seeking a long-term part-time opportunity, this could be a great fit.
About the Role
As a Part-Time Customer Support Agent at Assessio, you'll play an important role in delivering an excellent customer experience to our international clients.
You'll be part of our Global Support team, working closely with supportive, motivated colleagues who enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge, and having fun together.
Your main responsibility will be to help customers navigate our digital platforms, answer questions, and resolve issues efficiently and professionally.
You'll receive training in our products, systems, and support processes, giving you the opportunity to build valuable skills in customer service, HR technology, and SaaS-based solutions.
Working Hours & Availability

Part-time position: 20 hours per week

Fixed working hours: Thursdays and Fridays, 13:00–17:30

Remaining 11 hours scheduled flexibly by agreement

We're looking for someone interested in a long-term opportunity

Based in Stockholm or Amsterdam

 Your Responsibilities

Provide professional and friendly customer support via email and phone

Respond to customer inquiries in Dutch and English

Troubleshoot issues and guide customers through our digital platforms and assessment tools

Manage and follow up on support tickets to ensure timely resolutions

Collaborate with internal teams to resolve customer questions

Assist customers with questions related to assessment results and platform functionality

Handle administrative tasks related to customer support

Contribute to improving support processes and the overall customer experience

 Who We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who enjoys helping others, takes ownership of their work, and is eager to learn.
 Requirements:

Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken

Available to work Thursdays and Fridays between 13:00 and 17:30

Able to commit to 20 hours per week

Strong communication and problem-solving skills

Organized, reliable, and comfortable working independently

A genuine interest in customer service and delivering a great customer experience

You might be studying psychology, HR, business, or another relevant field, or simply looking for a rewarding part-time role alongside your other commitments.
 Nice to Have:

Previous experience in customer service, customer support, or technical support

Experience with CRM or ticketing systems, such as HubSpot

Interest in psychology, psychometric assessments, or HR technology

Experience working with SaaS platforms or other digital solutions

Swedish language skills

 What We Offer

A flexible part-time role of 20 hours per week

Hands-on experience in an international technology company

Training and ongoing support from experienced colleagues

Opportunities to develop your customer service, technical, and communication skills

A collaborative and welcoming team environment

The opportunity to grow professionally and explore future career opportunities within Assessio

 Why Join Assessio?
At Assessio, our mission is to help organizations make better people decisions and unlock human potential.
As part of our Global Support team, you'll contribute directly to that mission by helping customers get the most out of our assessment tools and services.
We value curiosity, collaboration, and personal development, and we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us.

Additional Information:

Start dater: As agreed

Scope: Part-time

Location: Banérgatan 16, Stockholm

Recruitment contact: Head of Global support
Ready to Join Us?

We'd love to hear from you!
We use a competency-based selection process. If you meet the criteria above, the first step will be to complete two assessments: a problem-solving test (Matrigma) and a personality test (MAP). Based on these results, we will make an initial selection for interviews and team meetings.
We review applications continuously, so if you find this role exciting – don’t wait, apply today!

 About Assessio
Assessio is one of the leading providers of Talent Assessment in the Nordics as well as the Netherlands. We deliver our services through modern, user-friendly, internally developed SaaS platforms. We have over 140 engaged employees in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Netherlands, France, Germany and Romania — all united under our shared vision of Zero Talent Waste.
We strive to contribute to a more efficient and fair labor market where people are assessed based on equal and relevant criteria. Our online products and digital solutions help our clients make effective, fair, and transparent decisions in recruitment and talent management processes.
Join us on our journey to become Northern Europe’s leading assessment company!

IES Norrtalje continues to expand and with this increase in student volume we are now looking for an extraordinary person to work in the school as an ‘NO Lärare’.

This role is one which requires a person who has the ability to multi-task´: One can find oneself working one on one with individuals and or with small groups in classrooms. Furthermore, we expect our NO teacher to follow the National Curriculum, but also expect NO subjects to inform students about general good behaviour and the correlation between Science and life. All teachers at IESN act as mentors to 15 students and our academic expectations are very high.

The suitable applicant needs to have the ability to engage with students across Mellanstadiet and Högstadiet and to believe in the IES ethos of good discipline, good manners and wherein going the extra mile to win is a given part of your inner characteristic.

Experience, positive socialisation with young children and winning their confidence, would be desirable skills that a bilingual NO Lärare would supply in abundance.

At IES Norrtalje engaging with students is not work, it is a calling!Vi söker dig som

- Har lärarbehörighet för ovan nämnda ämnen och åldrar. 

- Är trygg i ditt professionella ledarskap och skapar en trygg och stabil miljö både i och utanför klassrummet.

- Värdesätter och levererar ett personligt, tydligt och balanserat ledarskap med både kontroll och elevengagemang i fokus

- Är en entusiastisk och engagerad lärare med en stark vilja att bidra till både elevers och kollegors framgång.

- Har erfarenhet av att arbeta i skolan samt anpassa undervisning och arbeta tillsammans med elevhälsa och specialpedagoger.

- Känner dig bekväm med att undervisa och kommunicera både på svenska och engelska.Varför välja oss?

Hos oss blir du del av en engagerad och varm arbetsgemenskap där glädje, professionalism och samarbete går hand i hand. Du får chansen att göra verklig skillnad för elever – samtidigt som du får utvecklas i ditt yrke.

*För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se https://engelska.se/our-schools/norrtalje/

Vill du vara med och inspirera framtidens matematiker och samtidigt ta nästa steg i din karriär?

Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt fantastiska team!

Rekryteringen sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan (CV, personligt brev och lärarlegitimation) via vår IES Careers-webbplats eller till peter-john.fyles.norrtalje@engelska.se så snart som möjligt.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

Job Description
H&M is reshaping the future of promotions and customer incentives at a global scale! We are driving a major transformation across all our channels, involving significant architectural improvements, and unlocking endless business opportunities. 
We are looking for a Software Engineer with strong experience in backend development using Java to help drive and deliver our ongoing initiatives. Join us in redefining the tech landscape and building innovative solutions that create impact worldwide. 
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
Creating and delivering technical solutions to business challenges 
Delivering software solutions that run globally and impact millions of customers 
Develop in both spec-driven development fashion with AI agents and in traditional way 
Use engineering expertise to ensure AI-generated and manually developed solutions meet quality, performance, security, and maintainability standards, and participating in increasing said standards 
Maintain and contribute to the team’s strong collaboration culture 
Work on tests and automation around it 

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH  
You will be part of one of our dedicated product teams, collaborating closely with colleagues to bring these transformations to life. You are passionate about programming and take pride in delivering high-quality, polished solutions. As a developer, you have a genuine interest in the technology you work with, always striving to build a strong tech foundation that supports future ventures. You are eager to be involved in various parts of the development process: from design, build, test, deploy, monitor and maintain.   
We value teamwork, and we are looking for someone with excellent interpersonal skills who thrives in a dynamic, fun and engaging professional environment. If this sounds exciting, we want to hear from you!  
WHO YOU ARE  
Somone who is used to work in very collaborative fashion 
Hands on experience of end-to-end development in a microservice and cloud environment - from idea, design, build, test, deploy, monitor and running microservices at global scale in production  
3 to 5 years' experience in developing and testing applications/components  
Experience with Kubernetes and container technologies, such as Docker  
Advanced level of Java 21+ and prior working experience with Spring Boot and Spring Framework  
Practical experience developing though specification-driven development with LLMs 
Experience developing with AI agents, including effective context management, tool integration, and agent orchestration 
Creating, running and maintaining testing setups including component, integration and performance tests 
Automation through CI/CD pipelines including continuous deployment  
Excellent in English communication 

Nice to have:  
Have experience creating and running applications with LLMs and MCPs in production 
Ability to design and structure data models and knowledge repositories that enable reliable AI and agent-based solutions 
Hands-on experience integrating AI agent workflows with traditional engineering practices, such as CI/CD, test automation and automation of deployments 
Experience working in, or helping teams transition to, AI-agent-enabled development processes and ways of working. 
Experience with Azure, GCP 
Infrastructure as code, such as Terraform  
Database experience, such as NoSQL 

WHO WE ARE  
H&M Group is a global company with strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we use our scale and knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.  
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.  
All our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program (HIP)  
Staff discount usable across all H&M Group brands, in stores and online  
Work-life balance, 30 days’ vacation, and wellness allowance of 4000 SEK/year  
Access to Benify for discounts on gym memberships, travel, hotels, and more  
Compensation boost during parental leave  

JOIN US  
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are.  
This is a full-time, permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is hybrid, based in Stockholm, Sweden, where close collaboration with stakeholders is an important part of the role.  
Apply by submitting your CV in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through our career page. Application deadline 5th oct 2026 
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter.

Join Telavox as a Systems Engineer for Storage
Are you a hands-on systems engineer who thrives in operational depth and wants to own the storage that the rest of engineering runs on? At Telavox, we run our own: our own Ceph clusters, on-prem Kubernetes, and a fleet of physical servers across six countries. We're providers of infrastructure, not consumers of cloud - a deliberate choice, and what our product and economics demand. Storage is where we're investing next.
Ceph specifically is not a requirement. If you've run distributed or enterprise storage in production - Ceph, ZFS, Gluster, Lustre, MinIO, a vendor array - the instincts are what we're after, and we'll teach you ours.
About the job
This is a hands-on operations role. You'd own how our storage runs day-to-day - health, capacity, upgrades, expansion, and the operational foundations underneath it. You'll have real input into architecture, and you'll set the long-term direction with our storage lead rather than on your own. The emphasis here is deliberately operational - if making storage actually work, and being trusted to do it unsupervised, is the part you want, there's a lot of room in this role.
Ceph (block and S3) is our main estate - real production storage, growing across regions, with Sweden the largest footprint.
Your day-to-day would be mostly spent on things like:

Keeping the clusters healthy - issues, monitoring, capacity planning, upgrades, and expansion across regions

Getting the foundations right: stability, security, predictable scaling.

Making the work repeatable - runbooks, upgrade procedures that hold across regions, automation for what's manual today

You won't work in isolation from the rest of the platform: on-prem Kubernetes runs most of our workloads and has clear impact on the storage domain, and our Ansible-driven server and OS fleet spans six countries

How we work together:
You’ll join our Infrastructure Engineering team of around 15 people, working from our Malmö HQ, Gjuteriet, with international colleagues working remotely. English is our working language, and Swedish is a bonus.
There’s no mandatory on-call rotation, although Compute and Storage have an informal secondary list. You’ll have real ownership from day one, with plenty of room to identify, propose, and implement improvements. We also use Claude Code across Engineering, and you’ll help explore how it can support our platform work.
About you
You treat automation as the direction and repetition as its trigger, you factor in risk from the start rather than discovering it at the end, and you're pragmatic enough to do the manual work until automation catches up.
We're looking for:

Real operational depth in distributed or enterprise storage - a system you've run in production, been on the hook for, and debugged under pressure. Which system matters far less than how deeply

Strong Linux fundamentals - the substrate everything else sits on

Comfort taking an unclear problem, scoping it, and seeing it through

We strongly value experience with Ceph or object storage at scale, Ansible or similar configuration management, and operating systems across distributed environments. Experience with on-prem Kubernetes, server/OS lifecycle management, or firmware, BIOS, and BMC/IPMI is also a plus.
We’re looking for someone at a mid-to-senior level, with growth focused on deeper expertise, broader ownership, and becoming the go-to person for storage across the organisation.
Join us at Telavox 💚
Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!
How to apply!
At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.
We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English. 
For any questions, feel free to reach out to Emil Nilsson, Engineering Manager emil.nilsson@telavox.com. 
Learn more about what we do! ⬇️

We're looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to take ownership of the platform that powers our data products, from real-time APIs our customers depend on to the batch pipelines behind our analytics. You'll work across a lambda architecture that combines a low-latency streaming layer built in Go with a batch layer on Google Cloud, running on infrastructure spread across AWS, Azure, and GCP in regions around the world.
This is a hands-on senior role with real technical leadership. Beyond building and maintaining the platform, you'll set the bar for engineering quality on the team, shape how we design services so they stay modular and scalable as we grow, and act as tech lead and mentor for junior engineers.
Build and evolve the data platform
Develop and maintain our real-time layer, including the Go-based gateway and processing engine that serve customer-facing workloads with high availability and low latency.
Own and improve the batch layer on GCP, working with BigQuery, Airflow, and dbt to deliver reliable, well-modelled, and cost-efficient pipelines.
Keep the speed and batch layers consistent with each other, making sure data is correct, reconcilable, and trustworthy regardless of which path it takes.

Design and ship customer-facing backend services
Design, build, and operate backend APIs that customers use directly, with strong attention to contracts, versioning, performance, and backwards compatibility.
Think through failure modes, observability, and scaling up front, so services behave predictably in production.

Own multi-cloud infrastructure
Manage and evolve our infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP in multiple global regions using Terraform.
Improve how we structure infrastructure code through reusable modules, sensible environment separation, and safe, repeatable deployments.
Drive improvements in monitoring, alerting, security, and cost visibility across clouds. Participate in a shared on-call rotation for production systems.

Raise the bar on engineering excellence
Define and champion engineering standards around code quality, testing, code review, CI/CD, and documentation.
Lead technical design discussions and write clear design documents for significant changes, bringing the team along in the reasoning.
Identify technical debt and architectural weak points and build a pragmatic plan to address them alongside feature work.

Lead and mentor
Serve as tech lead for the team, guiding technical direction and helping prioritize work (this role has no direct reports).
Mentor two junior engineers through pairing, thoughtful code reviews, and gradually increasing ownership, helping them grow into confident, independent engineers.

REQUIREMENTS 
Significant professional experience as a software or data engineer (typically 6+ years), including time spent owning production systems end to end.
Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean and modular design, testing strategies, API design, and an understanding of distributed systems trade-offs.
Experience building and operating backend services in a compiled or typed language such as Go, Java, Kotlin, Rust, or similar.
Hands-on experience with a modern data stack, ideally BigQuery, Airflow, and dbt or close equivalents.
Solid experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, and working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider in depth.
Familiarity with both real-time/streaming and batch data processing patterns, and the challenges of combining them.
A track record of mentoring others and raising the quality of the teams you've been part of.
Clear written and verbal communication, especially the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to engineers of varying experience.

Nice to have
Professional experience with Go. This is a strong plus, though we'll happily support an experienced backend engineer in going deep on it.
Experience running infrastructure across multiple clouds and regions, including networking, identity, and data residency considerations.
Background with lambda or kappa architectures, event streaming systems (such as Kafka or Pub/Sub), or high-throughput API gateways.
Experience with observability tooling (metrics, tracing, logging) and cloud cost optimization.

Är du den SO och svensklärare som kan inspirera våra elever på IES Norrtälje?

Gillar du att göra SO och svenska både tydligt och engagerande? Trivs du i en internationell skolmiljö där du får möjlighet att utvecklas som både lärare och ledare? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig!

Vi söker en legitimerad SO och svensklärare för årskurs 4–9, med planerad start i januari 2027. 

Internationella Engelska Skolan i Norrtälje öppnade 2024 och har idag omkring 520 elever i årskurs F–9. 

Som medarbetare hos oss ingår du i ett arbetslag där ni tillsammans arbetar för att driva och utveckla verksamheten. Vi arbetar för att varje elev ska känna trygghet och trivsel i en lärande miljö. Vi arbetar för att väcka elevernas lust, engagemang, nyfikenhet och kreativitet. Varje elev ska få möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina förutsättningar och känna tilltro till sin egen förmåga. Undervisningen i SO och svenska sker på svenska, medan engelska används frekvent i kommunikationen mellan personal.Det här erbjuder vi

Hos oss får du:

- En internationell och inspirerande arbetsplats där svenska och engelska används parallellt.
- Kollegor som samarbetar, stöttar varandra och arbetar mot gemensamma mål.
- En skola med studiero, tydliga rutiner och en positiv kultur som gynnar både elever och personal.
- Möjligheten att ingå i en väletablerad organisation där din kompetens tas tillvara.

- Heltidstjänst.

- Ferieanställning med tillträde januari 2027. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna. Your role with us

IES Norrtalje continues to expand and with this increase in student volume we are now looking for an extraordinary person to work in the school as an ‘SO Lärare’. This role is one which requires a person who has the ability to multi-task´: One can find oneself working one on one with individuals and or with small groups in classrooms. Furthermore, we expect our SO teacher to follow the National Curriculum, teaching History, Geography, Religion and Civics, but also expect SO subjects to inform students about general good behaviour and the correlation between Humanities and life. All teachers at IESN act as mentors to 15 students and our academic expectations are very high. The suitable applicant needs to have the ability to engage with students across Mellanstadiet and Högstadiet and to believe in the IES ethos of good discipline, good manners and wherein going the extra mile to win is a given part of your inner characteristic. Experience, positively socialisation with young children and winning their confidence, would be desirable skills that a bilingual SO Lärare would supply in abundance. At IES Norrtalje engaging with students is not work, it is a calling!Vi söker dig som

- Har svensk lärarbehörighet för ovan nämnda ämnen och åldrar. 

- Är trygg i ditt professionella ledarskap och skapar en trygg och stabil miljö både i och utanför klassrummet.

- Värdesätter och levererar ett personligt, tydligt och balanserat ledarskap med både kontroll och elevengagemang i fokus

- Är en entusiastisk och engagerad lärare med en stark vilja att bidra till både elevers och kollegors framgång.

- Har erfarenhet av att arbeta i skolan samt anpassa undervisning och arbeta tillsammans med elevhälsa och specialpedagoger.

- Känner dig bekväm med att undervisa och kommunicera både på svenska och engelska.Varför välja oss?

Hos oss blir du del av en engagerad och varm arbetsgemenskap där glädje, professionalism och samarbete går hand i hand. Du får chansen att göra verklig skillnad för elever – samtidigt som du får utvecklas i ditt yrke.

*För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se https://engelska.se/our-schools/norrtalje/

Vill du vara med och inspirera framtidens matematiker och samtidigt ta nästa steg i din karriär?

Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt fantastiska team!

Rekryteringen sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan (CV, personligt brev och lärarlegitimation) via vår IES Careers-webbplats eller till peter-john.fyles.norrtalje@engelska.se så snart som möjligt.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

About Univrses
Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. While our roots are in the automotive sector, we have pioneered a new category: Infrastructure Intelligence. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.
The Mission
The Backbone of Operations: Every 3DAI™ deployment starts with a phone and a holder in a box. You make sure devices are set up, tested and shipped across Europe on time and fully traceable.

Quality at the Source: Our AI is only as good as its data. You help keep our annotation work accurate and on schedule.

The Heart of the Office: You shape the everyday experience of 40 scientists, engineers and business builders in our bright office by the water in Hammarby Sjöstad.

Established yet Agile: Founded in 2015, we have the stability of an established firm with the speed of a startup.

The Role
A hands-on, varied role spanning data, hardware, logistics and workplace. No two days look the same, and you'll be the go-to person who makes things happen.

Data Annotation & Quality: Annotate, re-annotate and validate data, monitor quality standards, and troubleshoot annotation tools.

Annotation Team Support: Help annotators meet productivity, quality and deadline targets. Train new annotators and answer questions about processes and tools.

Device Setup: Charge, configure and install apps on phones and car phone holders, create user accounts per internal guidelines, and test every device before it ships.

Packaging & Shipping: Pack collection kits according to checklists, label and document contents, ship via our providers, and log tracking so all hardware is traceable.

Inventory Management: Keep device and accessory inventory up to date, run regular stock checks, and initiate replenishment when stock runs low.

Office Coordination: Organise weekly team breakfast and Lunch & Learns (polls, food orders and all), manage office hardware, and handle deliveries, including pickups from local collection points.

Workplace Environment: Keep the office tidy and welcoming, from desks and fridges to fresh flowers, and proactively improve how we work.

Who You Are
Organised by Nature: You love structure, checklists and accurate records.

Hands-on and Practical: You're comfortable unboxing deliveries, setting up a phone, packing a shipment and fixing a basic tech issue, all in the same afternoon.

Detail-oriented: Whether validating annotations or labelling a package, you get it right the first time.

Service-minded: You enjoy helping colleagues and making the workplace better for everyone.

What You Bring
Required:

Experience: Background in office coordination, administration, operations, logistics or a similar hands-on role.

Tech Comfort: Confident setting up smartphones and apps and quick to learn new tools.

Accuracy: A track record of maintaining precise records, inventories or quality-controlled work.

Communication: Fluent English, with the ability to explain processes clearly and train others.

Preferred:

Experience with data annotation, labelling or quality assurance work.

Experience with inventory management, shipping or e-commerce logistics.

Swedish language skills.

AI-tool literacy — using AI to speed up your own workflows and problem-solving.

Driving licence.

What's in It for You?
We provide the environment and the tools for you to do the best work of your career.

Responsibility: Become a true stakeholder in a small team where your work keeps our operations running.

Variety and Growth: Gain exposure to AI data workflows, hardware deployment and international logistics, with real room to shape how we work.

The "Work-Life" Blend: A culture that values output over "desk time". Overtime is rare, something you don't find in many tech startups.

Upsides: A secure Pension Plan and Wellness activities for up to 5 000 SEK per year paid by the company.

The Univrses Culture:
Monday Momentum: Kick off the week with team breakfast.

Thursday Knowledge: Weekly Lunch & Learns with internal or external speakers, with catered lunch paid by the company.

Friday Wind-down: Celebrate the week's wins at Friday After Work (free beer from our well-curated beer fridge!).

The Workspace: A bright, collaborative office in Stockholm with the essentials (yes, including the mandatory startup ping-pong table).

Are You Our Next Office Manager and Data Annotator?
If you're an organised, hands-on problem solver who loves keeping things running smoothly, we want to hear from you.
To apply, please include the following:

Your CV

A cover letter

Note: All application materials must be in English.

ABOUT THE ROLE
 
We are seeking a hands-on, technically fluent engineer to drive the adoption of AI across our entire development organization - someone who finds the friction in how teams work and turns it into automated, AI-powered solutions.
As our AI Enablement Engineer, you will embed with engineering and product teams to identify where AI can remove repetitive, manual work, then build and ship the solutions that make it happen. You will work closely with our AI Efficiency Architects and AI Evangelist to turn high-level AI strategy into concrete, measurable wins on the ground.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys variety, moves fast, and gets real satisfaction from seeing their work adopted and relied upon by teams across the company.
 
Your Mission
Accelerate how the entire development organization works by finding high-impact use cases for AI, building the solutions that automate them, and spreading those wins so they scale across teams.
 
 
 
YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:
 

Use Case Discovery: work directly with engineering and product teams to map their workflows, spot repetitive or slow processes, and identify the highest-impact opportunities for AI-driven automation across the development organization.
Rapid Prototyping & Delivery: act as a builder - lead the technical design and implementation of working solutions such as prompt workflows, lightweight agents, scripts, and integrations that prove value fast, then partnering with the AI Efficiency Architects to harden anything that needs to run in production.
Reusable Enablement Assets: create templates, playbooks, and repeatable patterns so a proven AI win can spread from one team to many without bespoke work each time.
Adoption & Measurement: drive genuine adoption of AI tooling across teams and tie every solution back to concrete outcomes - time saved, throughput, and delivery speed - so impact is visible and quantifiable to leadership.
Feedback to the Platform: surface recurring needs and friction back to the AI Efficiency Architects, so the internal AI gateway and tooling evolve toward what teams actually need.
Technical Mentorship & Influence: mentor senior engineers on AI best practices and influence engineering roadmaps.

 
 
OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:
 
ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Staff-Level Engineering Foundations: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience (Java, Python, Go, or TypeScript) with a proven track record of delivering complex, distributed systems in a production environment.
Production-Ready AI Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience moving AI from a cool prototype to a real-world tool. You don’t just write basic prompts - you know how to build reliable agents and RAG workflows, and you understand the practical side of LLMs, like managing costs, speed, and context limits to make tools actually work for production.
Strategic Problem-Solving: You have a strong bias for action and can take a vague problem and turn it into a working solution fast. While you focus on delivering value quickly rather than chasing perfection, you always think big - building smart, reusable tools that fix root problems for hundreds of developers, not just one team.
Collaboration & Communication: excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work alongside many different teams, understand their needs, and bring them along on the adoption journey.
SDLC/DevOps Familiarity: working knowledge of the tools that underpin the software delivery lifecycle (e.g., GitLab/GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, source control) so that solutions fit naturally into how teams already work.
Self-Direction: capacity to manage a varied portfolio of work across multiple teams, prioritize for impact, and deliver with minimal supervision.

 
NICE TO HAVES

Excellent presentation and training skills
Previous experience running enablement, developer experience, or internal tooling initiatives

 
 
WHO WE ARE
 
At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!

Semin Group is investing in the Nordic market, and we're looking for someone who wants to be at the centre of that growth. As one of Europe's leading manufacturers of fillers, joint compounds and interior finishing solutions, Semin has built a strong presence across multiple European markets. We are now looking for a National Sales Developer to help establish and grow our business across the Nordic region.
This is a role for someone who enjoys building relationships, creating opportunities and developing business in the construction industry. You'll be responsible for introducing the Semin brand, developing customer relationships and building a strong market presence across Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland. While your activities may initially be focused on your local market, your role will contribute to Semin's growth across the Nordics.
If you enjoy being out with customers, developing new business and taking ownership of your results, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity

While your initial activities may be concentrated in your local market, your responsibility will extend across Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland. You will identify new business opportunities, develop relationships with key customers and distributors, and help establish Semin as a recognised partner throughout the Nordic construction industry.
You will have significant freedom to shape your approach, influence market development, and create new business opportunities across the region. Working closely with colleagues across Europe, you'll play a direct role in strengthening Semin's Nordic presence and supporting the company's continued international growth.

Work closely with international colleagues to support growth and customer success

At least 3 years of B2B sales experience within the construction industry

A proven track record in new business development

Meritorious

products or similar solutions

You'll Succeed in This Role If You

Enjoy meeting customers and building relationships

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.

Your tasks:
Your main responsibilities will be the following:
- Provide routine and emergency care
- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software
- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff
- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")
- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations
- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications
- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff
- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register
- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards
- Carry out workstation assessments
- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees
- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentation

Your profile:
- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)
- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".
- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.
- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).
- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.
- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.
- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.
- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.

What we offer:

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities.
